result.markdown:
If you're looking for alternatives to **Tally.so (the form builder)**, there are several excellent options depending on whether you want better design, more integrations, advanced conditional logic, or a similarly generous free plan.

My top recommendation is **Fillout**\. It's probably the strongest all-around alternative to Tally.

## Best Tally alternatives in 2026

![](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/kHEzI21OXAkY8Jb1WbRD_U5Rt3ulHMcf9iVl7eeZI436Ft9fCZM9-ZyaPv5W3haGWh-95kJan5GJ_Uc4Qj0EsAtLu9vKi7S63LCuAnROCfxeFVQ0oywBUqGhwKNtvLdV_ztmlHOvSnV3ITR3GT67_VY6A6ZxvtBzFl6GxyLRLDs3tdqOFGn4fn3HAD3C0cAe?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Fillout**

(Best overall)

- Advanced conditional logic
- Native Airtable, Notion and database integrations
- Multi-page forms and customizable design
- Generous free plan (1,000 responses/month reported)

[Website](https://www.fillout.com/)

- Beautiful conversational forms
- One question at a time
- Strong branding and customization
- Great for lead generation and surveys

## Quick comparison

| Platform | Best use case | Free plan |
|--------|--------|--------|
| Fillout | Advanced forms and integrations | 1,000 responses/mo |
| Typeform | Beautiful forms | Limited |
| Jotform | Complex forms | Limited |
| Paperform | Branded forms and payments | Limited |
| Youform | Tally-like experience | Unlimited\* |
| Google Forms | Basic forms | Free |
| Cognito Forms | Calculations and workflows | Limited |
| Formbricks | Surveys and feedback | Open-source option |


*Free-plan limits and features can change; check the providers' pricing pages before switching.*

## My recommendations

I'd narrow it down to these three\:

- **Fillout\:** If you want a more powerful Tally.
- **Youform\:** If you want something very similar to Tally without paying.
- **Typeform\:** If you want a more polished experience for customers.
